title: The honor-box payment share
hook: Two stated cases: explore the denominator behind two recorded payment rates.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the denominator behind two recorded payment rates affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Gap, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the denominator behind two recorded payment rates in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.

claims.text: A toy comparison has 87/100 in A and 90/100 in B. What is A minus B in percentage points?
